subject.title: [Bug]: Signal DM silently dropped on reply session initialization conflict (retry fix ported to Slack/Telegram but not Signal)

question: Which open Signal retry PR should become the canonical fix for this issue before the issue is closed?
rationale: Two external PRs currently close this issue, one is conflicting and both carry proof-gate labels, so creating another repair job would add churn instead of resolving the maintainer choice.

options.title: Review One Existing Candidate
options.body: Select the cleaner open Signal retry PR, require redacted live proof, and let the merged PR close this issue.

options.title: Consolidate The Duplicates
options.body: Close or pause duplicate retry branches only after the canonical branch is chosen or merged.

options.title: Request A Fresh Maintainer Fix
options.body: If neither candidate meets the desired shape or proof bar, keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned replacement.

recommendation.title: Review One Existing Candidate
recommendation.body: Select the cleaner open Signal retry PR, require redacted live proof, and let the merged PR close this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current Signal handler routing signal from current-main blame and PR metadata.
